explore-director.title: Add a shorter element
explore-director.prompt: Add a slightly shorter element and see which way the pattern moves.
explore-director.success: The pattern swings from the dipole toward the shorter element: it's a director.

explore-reflector.title: Now a longer one
explore-reflector.prompt: Replace it with a slightly longer element.
explore-reflector.success: Now the signal goes from the longer element toward the dipole: a reflector.
